Shangpeng Sun, Ph.D.

Assistant Professor

Department of Bioresource Engineering, McGill University

I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Bioresource Engineering at McGill University. I received my PhD degree from College of Engineering at the University of Georgia, Athens, USA. My main research interests are to develop and adopt innovative sensing technologies and AI-driven computational methodology for solving challenges in next-generation smart agriculture, improving the production of high-quality food in the face of the rapidly growing human population and global environmental change.

Recruiting

For Prospective Students / Postdocs
I am actively looking for strong and motivated students in the areas of deep learning, computer vision, 3D modeling, ag-robots, and digital agriculture. Also, we welcome CSC supported visiting students and professors. If you are interested in my research, please send me an email with the subject of “Prospective PhD/Master student [Your name]”, or apply through the McGill Slate system and mention me in your application. Due to the large volume of emails, I apologize for not replying to individual inquiries I have received. Please visit here for detailed information for your applications.
